judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a general framework and tool for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a technical specification/methodology, not a paper introducing this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper introduces iEEG-BIDS, a specification for storing and sharing iEEG data, which is a technical standard/methodology, not a paper describing the release of this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
